name: Summit AZ - 90-Day Before After 2026-09-23
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-23

# Summary
GSC comparison of 90 days before TAG (Mar 21 to Jun 18) vs 90 days with TAG (Jun 19 to Sep 16). TAG work on Summit AZ started 2026-06-19.

# Key numbers
- Clicks 145 to 131 (-9.7%); impressions 48,900 to 50,600 (+3.5%); CTR flat 0.3%; average position 29.6 to 29.1.
- Page-one queries 83 to 61 (-26%); service page-one queries 79 to 55 (-30%).
- Non-brand clicks: 4 in each period. The click decline is almost all the brand query "summit plumbing pros" (54 clicks at position 5 to 26 at 8.9).
- "near me" collapse: page-one "near me" queries 43 to 5 (-88%), impressions 8,418 to 3,983. Examples: plumbers near me 9.7 to 17.6; drain cleaning near me 8.3 to 17.1.
- Not the relaunch: cutting at Sep 2 (before the Sep 3 relaunch) the collapse had already happened (near-me page-one 49 to 5). The 24/7 copy removal (2026-09-09) is also after the window.
- Improved: specific service plus city terms (sewer line repair fountain hills 21.7 to 7.5, water softener maintenance tempe 55.2 to 10.0, /plumbing/ 24.1 to 9.0).

# Open
Cause of the "near me" drop is not established. Still to test: local algorithm update, local-pack association loss, NAP or schema changes, GBP signals, GSC artifact.
